# Papered v0.1.0 — Initial Release (Alpha)

> **⚠️ Alpha Notice**
> This is an early, experimental release. The API, CLI, data format, and database schema are subject to breaking changes without notice. Not recommended for production use.

Context infrastructure for research agents and researchers: a local-first paper knowledge engine that lets AI agents query precise, grounded literature information without interrupting your flow.

## Features

- **PDF Ingestion** — Import academic papers, extract text and figures with structure preservation
- **Semantic Sectioning** — Intelligent chapter/section splitting for targeted annotation
- **MCP Server** — Connect with AI clients via the Model Context Protocol for interactive paper analysis
- **HTTP Daemon** — REST API + Web UI for browser-based paper management
- **Web UI** — Clean interface for browsing and querying your paper library
- **Local-First** — All data stored locally via Turso/SQLite; no cloud dependency

## Installation

**macOS / Linux:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WuChenh/Papered/main/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WuChenh/Papered/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**From source (requires Rust toolchain):**
```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/WuChenh/Papered.git papered papered-daemon
```

Or download the pre-built binary for your platform from the assets below.
